name: Postale
source:
It is a time when space aviation is now commonly available to civilians. A young girl, Yu, decides to live as a delivery person in Mare Notamusica, a city on a planet far away from the Earth.

[From [url=https://tokinashi.itch.io/postale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如今，就连普通人也能轻易踏上太空之旅。少女优决定远离地球，在一颗遥远星球上的城市梅亚·诺塔穆西卡定居，以送货为生。

〔摘自[url=https://tokinashi.itch.io/postale]itch.io[/url]〕
